4:35 "Pure code, no AI, very deterministic" — seriously? Jev is a trained ML model (a classifier/cross-encoder) that computes logits and outputs probabilities with a confidence score. Pure deterministic code doesn't fail based on probabilities. Jev is a neural network classifier, which means it’s still AI — just discriminative rather than generative. Just because a model doesn't stream text token-by-token like Claude doesn't magically turn it into "deterministic code." Classifiers were AI long before ChatGPT came along. You throw the term "AI" around trying to sound like an advanced tech enthusiast, but in reality, you clearly don't even grasp the basics of what it means.
